title: PvE Lag Compensation
description: A mod that makes high ping players suffer a lot less.
body:
![The mod title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc5172ccc51120350a603627fc3c810029e0f8a4.png)
               
This mod improves PvE combat on multiplayer servers by making combat feel more responsive under ping. Attacks against mobs register more consistently, critical hits feel closer to singleplayer timing, and ghast fireball deflections are much more reliable.
The mod adjusts its compensation for each player individually based on their latency, so higher ping players get more help where they need it most. Server owners can also fine-tune how strong the compensation is through the config.
It is designed only for PvE and does not change PvP. It does not increase player reach or permanently enlarge entity hitboxes. The goal is simply to reduce the frustration of hits, crits, and fireball deflections failing because of lag.


Mod Comissioned by [FlameEliwood](https://x.com/FlameEliwood)
